result.reason: The operative language eliminates the existing three-year take-or-pay and, for any expressly agreed Order Form commitment, adopts the fallback protections: a single 12-month term, reduction on 30 days’ notice, termination with the relevant agreement or Order Form, and no penalty or take-or-pay shortfall payment. The changes are confined to the minimum-commitment issue and preserve unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because the initial categorical statement that there is no minimum commitment, and Section 12.3’s corresponding acknowledgement, conflict with the later authorization of Order Form volume commitments. In addition, the source, calculation, and treatment of the stated carry-forward credit are unclear, particularly if there is no following period.
